input: Sort out international health insurance for expats

gold.taskTitle: Sort Out International Health Insurance as Expat
gold.taskDescription: Research, compare, and secure an international health insurance plan suitable for living abroad as an expat.

questions.title: Which country are you moving to or living in?
questions.description: The destination country determines legal requirements, available providers, and coverage needs.

questions.title: How many people need to be covered?
questions.description: Establish whether this is for an individual, a couple, or a family with dependants.

questions.title: What is your monthly or annual budget for premiums?
questions.description: A clear budget range narrows down viable plan options significantly.

questions.title: Do you need coverage in your home country too?
questions.description: Some expats require worldwide coverage including their country of origin for visits home.

questions.title: Are there any pre-existing medical conditions to declare?
questions.description: Pre-existing conditions affect eligibility, exclusions, and the cost of plans across providers.

questions.title: Is this employer-sponsored or fully self-funded by you?
questions.description: Knowing who is paying determines how much flexibility exists in choosing a provider and plan tier.

questions.title: What is your deadline for having coverage in place?
questions.description: A start date or visa requirement deadline shapes how urgently the research and sign-up must happen.
